BiblicalUsage: Hasadiah means Jehovah has been faithful. He is named once, among the sons of Zerubbabel listed after the exile — Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed, five in all.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a boy named Jehovah has been faithful, born to a family that came home from exile, is a promise you can hold in your hand.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
